quest.title: The Gourmet Supremos: The Deep Divers
quest.description: The Gourmet Supremos seem to be in another fix...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Primogem x20, Recipe: Onigiri x1, Delicious Onigiri x3, Mora x10000

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: The Seagrass here is pretty good...

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: I wouldn't call this "picking Seagrass." It's more like "pulling Seagrass"...

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: If we used a small knife, we'd get them all in no time.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: We can't go down there like this...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What happened?

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Traveler, we meet again! We're currently trying to figure out how to... dive into the waters in front of us.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: We're going to grab ourselves some fresh Seagrass to make something known as "Onigiri."

choices.text: Couldn't you just get those from the seaside?

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: We could, but the Seagrass there generally isn't that fresh. There's always a little something missing in the flavor of dishes you make that way.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: I've asked around, and the locals say that good-quality Seagrass grows down here.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: But when we arrived today, we found that it had been completely flooded with seawater.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Even worse, none of us have any skill in diving, so we can only watch this all play out...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Are there any related mechanisms nearby?

response.speaker: Julie
response.text: There's one over there...

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: But it's stuck inside that barrier again, so we can't get in.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: *sigh* We'll continue trying to figure this out...

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Still, Traveler, do tell us if you know anything about how to solve this problem.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Of course, it would be best if you could just bring the Seagrass to us directly—

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: Mr. Xudong?

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: *cough* I mean, you will be well-compensated if you could bring us the Seagrass directly! I'll add on a great feast of Onigiri as further incentive!

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: Onigiri, "a great feast," pick one...

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Oh, come on, we just need to make more... *cough* Oh fine, fine. Let's keep trying to figure it out, shall we?

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Seagrass found by the seaside generally isn't that fresh. There's always a little something missing in the flavor of dishes you make that way.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Have you gathered any Seagrass, Traveler?

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Aha, yes, this is it. Thanks for your help, Traveler!

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Well, time to make that dish that they call... Onigiri, was it? I've heard that it's a simple enough dish to make...

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Alright, hang on while I prepare the food. It's going to take a while.

talks.objective: Bring the Fresh Seagrass to Xudong

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Now then. Seagrass... Fish... and Rice...

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: This should be how it goes...

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Yup, that should be it! I present to you all, the Onigiri!

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: How very... plain. Well, I'll take this one. I doubt I could finish any more...

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: Well, I say it's all good as long it tastes good! I'll have this one!

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: This serving's yours, Traveler — and of course, here's a copy of the recipe.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: They seem like the most simple thing in the world, these Onigiri, but there's some real technique to making them well.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Well then. I should have some myself. All that work's made me hungry...

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Hey, Parvaneh, I thought you said you couldn't finish!? Leave some for me, come on!

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Are we really going to have to find a way to dive down there?

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: Can't we switch locations? Do we really have to get our Seagrass here...

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: Oh, come on, why does that mechanism have to be inside that barrier again...

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: Hmm... There wouldn't be any ruins beneath this place by any chance, right?

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: R—Ruins? Well, it certainly would be nice if there were...

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: It looks like the area below has been flooded before...

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: Yup, and the water marks very obvious, too. This place was definitely flooded up till not long ago.

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: But why did the water suddenly retreat...

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: Ugh, this place is all wet. The water's going to get into my shoes...

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Well, forget it. Let's just gather some Seagrass as quickly as we can.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing over here?

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Oh? Would you look at that! So we meet again, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: We just went down to collect some Fresh Seagrass to make a dish known as Onigiri. It was pretty tough going down there. My shoes are soaked...

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: But that aside, Traveler, could you help us get some more Seagrass?

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: The area below seems to have been flooded not long ago, and while the water has retreated, there's no telling when it might come rushing back in again.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: As such, I think it might be best to gather a bit more Seagrass as quickly as we can.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: We're counting on you, Traveler.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Once you've gathered the Seagrass, please bring them back to me.

choices.text: Not going to pick some from the seaside?

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: We could, but the Seagrass there generally isn't that fresh. There's always a little something missing in the flavor from dishes you make that way.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: The quality of the Seagrass here should be superior by far. Either way, we'll need your help, Traveler.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Once you've gathered the Seagrass, please bring them back to me.
